project.name: WLJ Personal Data Query System
project.description: Build a context-aware AI assistant that queries user's personal WLJ data first, then falls back to general AI knowledge when no relevant data exists.

description.objective: Build a rule-based system that identifies when a user's question relates to their personal WLJ data.
actions: Create assistant/intent_detector.py file.
Define PERSONAL_DATA_KEYWORDS dictionary mapping data types to keyword lists (weight, journal, medication, food, mood).
Define DATE_KEYWORDS list for time-related phrases (since, last, average, how many).
Implement detect_personal_data_intent() function that returns dict with is_personal_query boolean, data_types list, and has_date_context boolean.
Add unit tests for various query patterns.
description.output: assistant/intent_detector.py with detect_personal_data_intent() function that accurately classifies user queries.

description.objective: Build a utility that extracts date references from natural language queries like 'since December 1st' or 'this week'.
actions: Create assistant/date_parser.py file.
Install dateutil package if not present (add to requirements.txt).
Implement extract_date_from_message() function with regex patterns for 'since', 'from', 'after' phrases.
Add relative date handling for 'this week', 'last week', 'this month', 'yesterday', 'today'.
Handle year defaulting when not specified.
Return None when no date reference is found.
Add unit tests for various date formats and edge cases.
description.output: assistant/date_parser.py with extract_date_from_message() function that parses natural language dates into datetime objects.

tasks.name: Create Personal Data Service - Weight Module

description.objective: Build the first data query method that retrieves and summarizes weight log data.
actions: Create assistant/data_service.py file.
Create PersonalDataService class with user attribute in __init__.
Implement get_weight_data() method that queries WeightLog model.
Filter by since_date when provided.
Return None if no entries exist.
Return dict with type, count, average, latest, latest_date, and entries (last 10).
Add unit tests with mock data.
description.output: assistant/data_service.py with PersonalDataService class and working get_weight_data() method.

tasks.name: Create Personal Data Service - Journal Module

description.objective: Add journal entry querying capability to the Personal Data Service.
actions: Open assistant/data_service.py.
Add get_journal_data() method to PersonalDataService class.
Query JournalEntry model filtered by user.
Filter by since_date when provided.
Return None if no entries exist.
Return dict with type, count, and latest_date.
Add unit tests with mock data.

tasks.name: Create Personal Data Service - Medication Module

description.objective: Add medication adherence querying with consistency calculation to the Personal Data Service.
actions: Open assistant/data_service.py.
Add get_medication_data() method to PersonalDataService class.
Query MedicationLog model filtered by user.
Filter by since_date when provided.
Calculate days_with_logs using dates() aggregation.
Calculate total_days from since_date or first log date to now.
Calculate consistency_percent as (days_with_logs / total_days) * 100.
Return None if no entries exist.
Return dict with type, total_logs, days_logged, total_days, and consistency_percent.
Add unit tests with mock data.
description.output: PersonalDataService has working get_medication_data() method with consistency calculation.

description.objective: Build the unified query_by_intent() method that dispatches to appropriate data methods based on detected intent.
actions: Open assistant/data_service.py.
Add query_by_intent() method to PersonalDataService class.
Create query_map dictionary mapping data type strings to method references.
Loop through data_types and call corresponding methods.
Collect results into dict, skipping None responses.
Return results dict or None if empty.
Add integration tests covering multiple data types.
description.output: PersonalDataService has query_by_intent() method that fetches all relevant data in one call.

description.objective: Build a formatter that converts query results into natural language context for the AI prompt.
actions: Create assistant/context_builder.py file.
Implement build_personal_context() function.
Return empty string if data_results is None or empty.
Format weight data with count, average, and most recent values.
Format journal data with count and latest date.
Format medication data with consistency percentage and totals.
Add closing instruction for AI to use the data.
Return formatted string.
Add unit tests for various data combinations.
description.output: assistant/context_builder.py with build_personal_context() function that produces AI-readable data summaries.

description.objective: Wire all components together in the main assistant processing function with fallback logic.
inputs: Existing assistant view or processing function
actions: Open assistant/views.py (or equivalent processing file).
Import all new modules.
Create or update process_assistant_message() function.
Call detect_personal_data_intent() on user message.
If is_personal_query is True, call extract_date_from_message().
Instantiate PersonalDataService and call query_by_intent().
If data exists, call build_personal_context().
Build system_prompt with personal context if available, or generic prompt if not.
Pass system_prompt and user_message to AI API call.
Return AI response.
Add integration tests for full flow.
description.output: Assistant view processes queries with personal data priority and general knowledge fallback.

tasks.name: Add Food Log Data Service Method

description.objective: Extend Personal Data Service to query food log entries including calorie summaries.
actions: Open assistant/data_service.py.
Add get_food_data() method to PersonalDataService class.
Query FoodLog model filtered by user.
Filter by since_date when provided.
Calculate total_entries, average_daily_calories, and latest_date.
Return None if no entries exist.
Update query_map in query_by_intent() to include food.
Add unit tests with mock data.

tasks.name: Add Mood Tracking Data Service Method

description.objective: Extend Personal Data Service to query mood log entries with trend analysis.
actions: Open assistant/data_service.py.
Add get_mood_data() method to PersonalDataService class.
Query MoodLog model filtered by user.
Filter by since_date when provided.
Calculate average_mood, count, and mood_distribution (counts per mood level).
Return None if no entries exist.
Update query_map in query_by_intent() to include mood.
Add unit tests with mock data.

tasks.name: Update Context Builder for New Data Types

description.objective: Extend context builder to format food and mood data for AI prompts.
inputs: data_results dict potentially containing food and mood data
actions: Open assistant/context_builder.py.
Add formatting block for food data (entries, average calories, latest date).
Add formatting block for mood data (average mood, distribution, count).
Add unit tests for new data type combinations.
description.output: build_personal_context() function handles all five data types.

tasks.name: Add Intent Detection Tests and Refinement

description.objective: Expand keyword coverage and add edge case handling to intent detection.
inputs: User feedback or logs of missed intents
actions: Review any logged queries that were incorrectly classified.
Add additional keywords to PERSONAL_DATA_KEYWORDS for each data type.
Add handling for compound queries (e.g., 'weight and mood this week').
Add handling for negation or meta-questions (e.g., 'have I logged my weight' vs 'what is my weight').
Update unit tests to cover new patterns.
description.output: Intent detector handles broader range of natural language queries.

description.objective: Implement caching to reduce database queries for repeated or similar assistant questions.
actions: Determine appropriate cache duration (e.g., 5 minutes for personal data).
Create cache key generator based on user_id, data_type, and since_date.
Wrap each get_*_data() method with cache check.
Invalidate relevant cache when user creates new log entries.
Add cache invalidation signals to log model save methods.
Test cache hit/miss behavior.
description.output: Personal data queries are cached appropriately with automatic invalidation on new entries.
